claim.purpose: Repair the final v0.91.8 external-review documentation packet while leaving WP-19 #5357 open for the actual review.

initial.title: [v0.91.8][docs][external-review] Repair final handoff packet readiness before WP-19 review
initial.goal: Make the v0.91.8 external-review packet complete, current, portable, and reviewable before WP-19 dispatch.
initial.required_outcome: The full review corpus validates and the handoff names real implementation/proof entrypoints without stale live-state claims or machine-local requirements.
authority_boundary: WP-19 #5357 remains open and owns the external review
No product source or release state is changed
initial.task_boundary: Populate and validate the packet, obtain one bounded review, and publish a docs-only corrective PR.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The handoff manifest names concrete tracked implementation, test, and evidence entrypoints
AC-2: Current issue-state statements match live GitHub truth
AC-3: The sendable corpus requires no workstation-local root
AC-4: Corpus structure, links, schemas, paths, redaction, and diff hygiene pass
dependencies: WP-16, WP-17, and both WP-18 review passes remain merged and ancestral
non_goals: No release approval or v0.92 activation
initial.plan_summary: Repair six bounded documentation surfaces, validate the complete corpus, perform one pre-PR review, and publish.

steps.action: Repair manifest, live issue truth, and portable commands
Run full corpus validation and bounded review
Publish a docs-only PR that closes #5804 and leaves WP-19 open

risks: A current-truth correction could overwrite a dated historical snapshot
A manifest entry could point to an absent path
The handoff could accidentally overclaim review completion
invariants: Release approval and v0.92 activation remain false
stop_conditions: A required implementation or proof surface is absent
Live issue truth cannot be verified
review_prompts: Does the manifest cover real landed implementation and proof rather than docs-only placeholders?
Are live state and historical snapshots distinguished correctly?
Can an external reviewer use the packet without machine-local paths?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate the complete v0.91.8 documentation corpus and handoff structure
Verify merged predecessor review and quality gates

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing paths, stale current truth, machine-local requirements, broken links, parse failures, or an actionable review finding.
